sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR H R A CHOUDHURY Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER Date : --23.03.2023.
Heard Mr. H.R.A. Choudhury, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. P. Borthakur,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioners namely, 1. Saddam Hussain, 2. Ismail Hussain, 3. Hasan @ Fakrul Hasan Khan, who are apprehending arrest in connection with Jogighopa P.S. Case No.
96/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that the accused/petitioners are innocent and no way connected with the alleged offence and their names have been falsely implicated here in this case.
He is a businessman dealing with the business of clothes in Bongaigaon town.
The petitioners are ready to appear before the I.O. and shall co-operate in the further investigation of the case if is granted with the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail.

In this context, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Mr. P. Borthakur, Page No.# 3/4 has submitted that the name of the present accused/petitioners find mentioned in the F.I.R. and as per the allegation made in the F.I.R., they were submitting fake GST Challan and hence, his custodial interrogation may be necessary in this case and accordingly, raised objection in granting pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner.
Having heard the submissions of learned counsels of both sides, it is provided that the Case Diary be called for fixing 21.04.2023.

Further, considering the submissions of learned counsels for both sides and also considering the materials placed on record, I find it a fit case to extend the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner till receipt of the Case Diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the above named accused/petitioners, namely, in connection with Jogighopa P.S. Case No.
96/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code, shall be enlarged on interim pre-arrest bail on his executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) each only with one surety of like amount each to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the following conditions:
Page No.# 1/4 vs Page No.# 2/4 on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118550588/
2 (i)that the petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of 1 (one) week from today;
(ii) that the petitioners shall fully co-operate with the investigation of the case and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required in connection with the investigation of the aforesaid P.S. Case; and (iii) that the petitioners shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
Page No.# 4/4 Call for the case diary List the matter on 03.04.2023.
